svg.text: Collect the installers and recovery point
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 · browser and your backup notes
Get the free self-hosted osTicket package from osticket.com/download. For PHP, open
https://www.php.net/downloads.php → Windows downloads → PHP 8.4 → x64 Non Thread Safe → Zip.
Require PHP 8.4.27 or a newer security-patched 8.4 release; older 8.4 builds do not contain the
October 21, 2026 fixes for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Also obtain a maintained
MariaDB 10.11 x64 Windows MSI from mariadb.org.
Choose the runtime ZIP, not the source, debug pack or development SDK. Check the ZIP
filename/version and compare its SHA-256 with the value on the official download page. Save the
trusted ZIP and version record outside the website folder.
Also obtain Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Redistributable and Microsoft IIS URL Rewrite
2.1 from their official sites. Avoid old all-in-one tutorial bundles and retired Web Platform
Record the exact versions. Back up APP01 before changes; a short-lived VMware checkpoint of
this disposable member VM is a convenience, not a database backup and never an AD recovery
Check: You have trusted installers, version notes and a recovery plan.
